description_en: Updates the configuration of an application in a Container Service for Kubernetes (ACK) or Serverless Kubernetes cluster
description_zh: 调用UpdateK8sApplicationConfig接口修改容器服务K8s或Serverless K8s集群中应用的配置
name: UpdateK8sApplicationConfig

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application. You can query the application ID by calling the ListApplication operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423162.html
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，可以调用ListApplication接口获取，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423162.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cluster. You can query the cluster ID by calling the ListCluster operation. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/411844.html
parameters.help_zh: 集群ID，可以调用ListCluster接口获取，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/411844.html
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of CPU cores allowed for each application instance when the application is running. The value 0 indicates that no limit is set on CPU cores
parameters.help_zh: 应用运行过程中，应用实例的CPU限额，单位：核。设置为0表示不做限制
parameters.name: cpu_limit

parameters.help_en: The maximum size of memory allowed for each application instance when the application is running. Unit: MB. The value 0 indicates that no limit is set on the memory size
parameters.help_zh: 应用运行过程中，应用实例的内存限额，单位：MB。设置为0表示不做限制
parameters.name: memory_limit

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of CPU cores allowed. The value 0 indicates that no limit is set on CPU cores
parameters.help_zh: CPU能使用的最大值，单位：核数。设置为0表示不做限制
parameters.name: mcpu_limit

parameters.help_en:
The number of CPU cores requested for each application instance when the application is running. Unit: cores. We recommend that you set this parameter. The value 0 indicates that no limit is set on CPU cores.

You must set this parameter together with the CpuLimit parameter. Make sure that the value of this parameter does not exceed that of the CpuLimit parameter
parameters.help_zh:
应用运行过程中，应用实例需要申请的CPU配额，推荐设置。单位：核数，设置为0表示不限制。

设置该参数时，还需要设置CpuLimit参数，且需要小于等于CpuLimit的参数值
parameters.name: cpu_request

parameters.help_en:
The minimum number of CPU cores required. Unit: cores. The value 0 indicates that no limit is set on CPU cores.

You must set this parameter together with the CpuLimit parameter. Make sure that the value of this parameter does not exceed that of the CpuLimit parameter
parameters.help_zh:
CPU最小资源需求，单位：核数。设置为0表示不限制。

设置该参数时，还需要设置CpuLimit参数，且需要小于等于CpuLimit的参数值
parameters.name: mcpu_request

parameters.help_en:
The size of memory requested for each application instance when the application is running. Unit: MB. We recommend that you set this parameter. If you do not want to apply for a memory quota, set this parameter to 0.

You must set this parameter together with the MemoryLimit parameter. Make sure that the value of this parameter does not exceed that of the MemoryLimit parameter
parameters.help_zh:
应用运行过程中，应用实例需要申请的内存配额，推荐设置。单位：MB。设置为0表示不申请。

设置该参数时，还需要设置MemoryLimit参数，且需要小于等于MemoryLimit的参数值
parameters.name: memory_request

parameters.help_en: The timeout period of the change process. Valid values: 1 to 1800. Default value: 600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 变更流程超时时间，单位：秒。取值范围1~1800秒，默认值为600秒
parameters.name: timeout

parameters.help_en:
The minimum size of space required by ephemeral storage. Unit: GB. The value 0 indicates that no limit is set on the ephemeral storage space.

You must set this parameter together with the EphemeralStorageLimit parameter. Make sure that the value of this parameter does not exceed that of the EphemeralStorageLimit parameter
parameters.help_zh:
临时存储最小资源需求，单位：GB。设置0表示不限制。

设置该参数时，还需要设置EphemeralStorageLimit参数，且需要小于等于EphemeralStorageLimit的参数值
parameters.name: ephemeral_storage_request

parameters.help_en: The maximum size of space required by ephemeral storage. Unit: GB. The value 0 indicates that no limit is set on the ephemeral storage space
parameters.help_zh: 临时存储资源需求上限，单位：GB。设置0表示不限制
parameters.name: ephemeral_storage_limit

ChangeOrderId.description_en: The ID of the change process

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code that is returned

Message.description_en: The additional information that is returned
